responsibility: Defines RTL machine-description patterns for the standard RISC-V bit-manipulation extensions, especially Zba/Zbb/Zbs-style integer operations and the combine/split logic needed to recognize them. It maps generic RTL forms such as shifts, bit extraction/insertion, min/max, population-count-like idioms, and branch-on-bit forms onto concrete bitmanip instructions, while also providing peephole-like define_split and define_insn_and_split rules that reshape surrounding arithmetic and masking expressions so later combine and reload can emit efficient specialized instructions instead of longer base-ISA sequences.
